Name: Red Critical Blow
Text: Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. Raise your anger 1 level. If successful, and you declared a tokui-waza, you may discard the top card of your life deck. If you do, draw a card. Remove from the game after use. DBZ League Only

Name: Red Energy Hold
Text: Stops a physical attack. Raise your anger 1 level. If you declared a tokui-waza, attach this card to your opponent's MP. While attached, your opponent's attacks deal -X stages of damage, where X= your anger level. You may only have 1 Red Energy Hold attached at a time. Discard this card when your opponent's MP advances a personality level. DBZ League Only

Name: Red Negation
Text: Stops the effects of any combat card. Use when needed. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, raise your anger 2 levels or draw a card. Limit 1 per deck. Remove from game after use. DBZ League Only

Name: Frieza's Deception
Text: [This card is unaffected by Constant Combat Powers.] Discard the top 3 cards of your Life Deck. Advance your opponent's Main Personality 1 level. This card counts as 1 copy of "Frieza's Irritation Grows" while in your discard pile. DBZ League Only

Name: Orange Rising Energy
Text: Energy attack or raise your MP to its highest power stage. Attach this card to your Trunks Saga Orange Style Mastery. While attached, your Orange style energy attacks deal +1 life card of damage, and after taking damage from a physical attack the first time each combat, raise your MP to its highest power stage. You may only have 1 Orange Rising Energy attached at a time.

Name: Orange Kaio-Ken Outburst
Text: Transform. Focused Energy Attack doing 6 life cards of damage. If successful, attach this to your main personality. While attached, if your opponent would deal power stages of damage with an attack, you may instead take the damage as Life Cards. If stopped, remove from the game after use.

Name: Orange Right Blast
Text: Transform. Focused energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. Discard an opponent's ally in play. If successful, search your life deck for a drill and set it aside. Place the chosen drill into play at the end of combat. Remove from game after use. DBZ League Only

Name: Heroic Deeds
Text: [You cannot name or affect a Main Personality card, Dragon Ball, Sensei, or Mastery with this card.] Heroes Only. Energy attack. You may shuffle a card in play into its owner's life deck.

Name: Lonely Canyon
Text: Energy attacks cost -2 power stages to perform.

Name: Orange Aura Deflection
Text: Transform. Stops a physical attack. Raise your anger 1. For the remainder of combat, your Orange style attacks cost -2 power stages to perform, to a minimum of 0. Remove from the game after use.

Name: ____'s Left Leg Check
Text: Stops a physical or energy attack. Gain 3 Power Stages. You may remove a named card matching your main personality in your discard pile from the game to shuffle this into your life deck. This card is considered a named card matching your main personality for deck construction and gameplay.

Name: Orange Negation
Text: Stops the effects of any combat card. Use when needed. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, raise your Main personality to its highest power stage and search your life deck for an Orange style drill and place it into play. Limit 1 per deck. Remove from game after use. DBZ League Only
